messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — elevated error rate on text-gen route (svc=query-router). Alert id: INC-2026-0315-07
ana_oncall: saw the pager. spike in 5xxs, started ~12:07 UTC. attaching head sample logs.
sam_backend: looking — quick summary: route policy pushed 12:01 UTC that added a new policy entry for 'fast-llm' -> variant v2-q8. traffic started shifting at 12:05 but we got a surge of retries and timeouts after 12:07.
lee_infra: infra metrics show region-us-west node pools tripping connection errors and then region fallback kicking to eu-central repeatedly. looks like a routing oscillation.
maria_prodeng: customer impact: a few enterprise tenants reported slow completions and partial responses. CS flagged two customers.
nana_oncall: can someone confirm whether decision logs have the route tag for the sample requests? I can't find route_id in the decision dump.
sam_backend: checking decision-logs. hmm — entries exist but missing route_tag and variant metadata for the failed requests. only see: { "request_id": "r-...", "decision": "route_candidate_selected" }
lee_infra: that explains why we couldn't trace the fallback chain. our aggregation relies on route_tag to correlate retries.
nana_oncall: priority: stop customer impact. mitigation idea: rollback the 12:01 policy change to restore previous routing. can we toggle to policy v1?
sam_backend: I can revert the policy entry to the previous ACL (pin to v1) — rolling back now. will POST the rollback command and follow up with a canary.
sam_backend: ```bash
# rollback
curl -X POST https://platform/api/policies/route -d '{"name":"fast-llm","action":"pin","variant":"v1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
incbot: deploybot: policy-service rollback started by sam_backend at 12:23 UTC.
lee_infra: after rollback, region fallback events dropped sharply. 5xx rate down 68% within 3 minutes.
maria_prodeng: CS notified affected customers and opened tickets. tagging for postmortem.
nana_oncall: handing off to lee_infra for mitigation monitoring. @lee_infra you are primary, @sam_backend secondary. pagerduty-bot: notify on any regression.
lee_infra: ack. monitoring for 30m. will collect example request IDs and any remaining anomalies.
sam_backend: follow-up: decision logs sampled before the rollback show the policy-service returned candidate list but omitted variant metadata when a candidate came from a fallback region. looks like a serialization bug in policy evaluation that strips route tags if region != primary.
maria_prodeng: that matches customer reports — they saw requests routed to a smaller-capacity eu-central variant unexpectedly.
nana_oncall: action items (short):
- immediate: policy rollback (done) and monitor 30m.
- triage: reproduce locally with test harness, add unit test for variant metadata retention.
- postmortem: root cause analysis and add alert for missing route_tag in decision logs.
lee_infra: capturing logs: `decision-service.log` and `router-proxy.log` saved to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1949504321/ for postmortem.
sam_backend: minimal repro added to infra-runner. snippet: ```python
# simulate candidate merging
candidates = evaluate_policy(request)
# bug: merging drops candidate['variant'] when fallback
merged = merge_candidates(candidates)
# ensure variant preserved
assert all('variant' in c for c in merged)
```
incbot: incident severity downgraded to Sev3 at 12:46 UTC — traffic stabilized, no ongoing degradation.
maria_prodeng: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC. invite: prodeng, infra, backend, oncall.
lee_infra: leaving monitoring in place until end of the rotation. will escalate if any anomaly > 5% baseline.
nana_oncall: thanks team. please file follow-ups in the postmortem doc and include exact request IDs and decision-log extracts.
sam_backend: filing PR with fix and unit test now. reference: #PR-ops/1949
maria_prodeng: note for postmortem: customer impact timeline, communication notes, and remediation timeline should be included.
lee_infra: one more: add a short-term synthetic that asserts presence of `route_tag` and `variant` in decision logs on every deploy.
nana_oncall: handoff complete. leaving note: if anything flares, page me immediately. :thumbsup:
